item.title: Opinion: If Ottawa doesn't reform supply management, Washington will
item.description: Supply management serves legitimate policy objectives: territorial occupation, income stability, and a degree of food sovereignty. But it is currently too rigid and too costly. The system needs modernization, not blind defence.
